messages:
tara: Heads-up: Horizon (acct horizon-501) spiked embedding consumption overnight. QBR in 5 business days. Need a dollarized 30/90 day forecast and a short mitigation plan to present.

mike: Can we get prod/dev split and identify if this is a scheduled job or runaway loop?

alejandra: Quick pull: prod=120M tokens last 7d, dev=6M. Baseline prod week ~15M. Looks like an automated backfill started Fri 23:00 UTC.

tara: Yikes. Immediate asks: 1) set non-prod hard cap, 2) create budget alert at 60% of projected month spend, 3) recommend switching to quantized embed model + prefix caching.

cs-bot: [Alert Created] budget_alert:horizon-501:60pct  notifies @tara @mike @alejandra. Daily anomaly monitor enabled.

mike: For the forecast use placeholder price $0.0005/1k tokens. Also include two scenarios in the deck: sustain vs mitigated. I'll draft renewal talking points if this looks like a repeat offender.

alejandra: Quick math: current run rate ~ (120M+6M)/7*30 ~ 558M tokens/mo => 558,000k * $0.0005 = $279k/mo. With prefix caching (-35%) + quantized model (-12%) + 50% throttle on batch jobs (which are ~75% of prod) projected spend drops to ~ $55k70k/mo. I'll add exact line item math into the QBR appendix.

tara: Good. Action items: alejandra prepares 30/90 day dollarized forecast + SQL appendix (due tomorrow), mike prepares renewal risk blurb + AE script (due in 48h), tara schedules enablement call and collects their ML lead feedback during the call.

alejandra: I'll also include copyable commands to find the top 10 jobs by token usage and a sample curl to enact a per-key throttle.

cs-bot: Will escalate to @mike if daily tokens exceed 2x baseline for 2 consecutive days.

tara: Thanks team. We'll rehearse slides 24h before the QBR.
